scenarios.assertion: Wasm constructs the goal, decodes feedback/result and checks fresh native joint positions.
The missing send capability returns DENIED; fresh native positions remain unchanged.
Truncated goals, invalid memory/ranges, stale handles and cancel-any through cancel-own authority are refused with unchanged output canaries.
Wasm cancels its own active native goal and observes the canceled terminal result and stable stopped positions.
An explicitly authorized absent server times out using the guest monotonic clock without native movement.
An actual gateway exit yields DISCONNECTED; close retires the handle without crashing the VM.
A real handle remains usable after another VM attempts to use or close its numeric value.
A simultaneously executing VM rejects the other VM handle without altering its output.
